text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past purchases as broad, continuing interest in related product families, brands, or musical styles.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they support a concrete task established by repeated purchases, such as measuring parts, connecting peripherals, or expanding storage.",
    "Entertainment recommendations align when they preserve specific artist, melodic, or stylistic connections to recent choices."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broad associations repeatedly substitute for an established need, producing printing supplies for repair users and unrelated devices for accessory buyers.",
    "Related products remain weak choices when they require unestablished equipment, incompatible dimensions, or functions already covered by recently purchased items.",
    "Entertainment selections often cross meaningful boundaries in intensity, mood, and listening purpose despite sharing a broad genre."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared product family, brand ecosystem, or broad genre appears to stand in for a specific reason to choose an item.",
    "Multiple variants of the same unsupported product need repeatedly occupy top positions."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent and repeated behavior provides stronger evidence of current tasks or listening preferences than isolated older interactions.",
    "Practical choice depends on compatibility, equipment ownership, and whether an item adds useful capability rather than duplicates it.",
    "Entertainment choice depends on specific sound, mood, artist continuity, and occasion rather than broad category membership."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top positions repeatedly contain broadly related items without a supported current purpose, crowding out choices connected to users' specific tasks or recent tastes.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked items users would choose for a concrete purpose supported by their histories.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked items rejected for incompatible specifications, assumed equipment ownership, or redundant functionality.",
    "The concentration of repeated recommendations around a product need unsupported by the user's history.",
    "The frequency of entertainment rejections attributed to mood, intensity, or stylistic mismatch, tracked separately from cases where relevance cannot be assessed because item identity is unknown."
  ]
}
